
/* ========== 第 1 页 ========== */
// ===== 文件: AgentKernel.ets (444 行) =====
/**
 * uniterm M6 relay3 - AI 智能体内核(ArkTS 原生, hmharness 式多轮 function-calling)。
 *
 * 回路: run(userText) → while(round < 12):
 *   chatWithTools(带 4 工具) → 有 tool_calls → 逐个过审批门(需确认时 emit 审批卡
 *   + Promise 挂起, UI 允许/拒绝回调续跑) → 执行 → role:'tool' 回填 → continue;
 *   无 tool_calls → 最终答复, done。
 *
 * 4 工具(走既有服务):
 *   term_write(cmd)    → SessionService.write(危险判定黑名单正则)
 *   term_read(lastN)   → SessionService.screenText
 *   session_info()     → 会话状态快照
 *   sftp_list(path)    → ssh.sftpList(sessionId)
 *
 * 审计: 每轮 append filesDir/agent-audit.jsonl(ts/round/tool/args/result 摘要)。
 * 上下文预算: term_read lastN≤40 行; 历史消息 >20 轮时截断中间。
 * 全程事件回调驱动 UI(无后台 setInterval);轮次推进靠 Promise 续跑。
 */
import { hilog } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit';
import fs from '@ohos.file.fs';
import { Llm, LlmConfig, LlmMsg, OaiToolCall } from './Llm';
import { LlmConfigStore } from './LlmConfigStore';
import { SessionService } from './SessionService';
import { AgentSettings, AgentSettingsStore, ApprovalMode } from './AgentSettingsStore';

const TAG: string = 'oat.agent';
const DOMAIN: number = 0x0110;
const MAX_ROUNDS: number = 12;
const MAX_HISTORY: number = 20;

/** 内核发往 UI 的事件(AIDock 渲染三类消息 + 审批卡)。 */
export interface KernelEvent {
  kind: string
  // 'user' 用户指令 | 'assistant' 模型文本 | 'tool' 工具卡(name+args+result)
  // | 'need_approval' 审批请求(callId+name+args) | 'approved'/'denied' 审批结果
  // | 'round' 轮次指示 | 'done' 完成 | 'err' 错误
  text: string
  name: string
  args: string
  result: string
  callId: string
  round: number
}

/** 审计 jsonl 单行结构。 */
interface AuditRow {
  ts: number
  round: number
  tool: string

/* ========== 第 2 页 ========== */
  args: string
  ok: boolean
  approved: boolean
  result: string
}

export class AgentKernel {
  static onEvent: (e: KernelEvent) => void = (e: KernelEvent) => {
  }
  private static busy: boolean = false
  private static round: number = 0
  // 审批挂起: callId → resolver(true=允许 / false=拒绝)
  private static pendingResolve: ((ok: boolean) => void) | null = null
  private static pendingCallId: string = ''

  /** UI 允许按钮回调(续跑挂起的轮次)。 */
  static approve(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'approve callId=%{public}s', AgentKernel.pendingCallId)
    const r = AgentKernel.pendingResolve
    if (r !== null) {
      AgentKernel.pendingResolve = null
      AgentKernel.pendingCallId = ''
      r(true)
    }
  }

  /** UI 拒绝按钮回调(工具结果=已拒绝, 模型继续)。 */
  static deny(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'deny callId=%{public}s', AgentKernel.pendingCallId)
    const r = AgentKernel.pendingResolve
    if (r !== null) {
      AgentKernel.pendingResolve = null
      AgentKernel.pendingCallId = ''
      r(false)
    }
  }

  /** 4 工具的 OpenAI tools 参数 JSON(Record 组装避免双重序列化)。 */
  static toolsJson(): string {
    // parameters JSON Schema 子对象(properties 值必须是 schema 对象, 非描述文本)
    const p1: Record<string, Object> = {}
    const p1cmd: Record<string, Object> = {}
    p1cmd['type'] = 'string'
    p1cmd['description'] = 'shell 命令文本(不含换行结尾)'
    p1['cmd'] = p1cmd
    const fn1p: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn1p['type'] = 'object'
    fn1p['properties'] = p1
    const fn1req: string[] = ['cmd']
    fn1p['required'] = fn1req

/* ========== 第 3 页 ========== */
    const fn1: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn1['name'] = 'term_write'
    fn1['description'] = '在当前终端会话执行一条 shell 命令并等待输出完成。危险命令需用户审批。'
    fn1['parameters'] = fn1p

    const p2: Record<string, Object> = {}
    const p2n: Record<string, Object> = {}
    p2n['type'] = 'number'
    p2n['description'] = '返回最后 N 行'
    p2['lastN'] = p2n
    const fn2p: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn2p['type'] = 'object'
    fn2p['properties'] = p2
    const fn2: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn2['name'] = 'term_read'
    fn2['description'] = '读取终端屏幕最近输出。lastN: 返回最后 N 行(1-40, 默认 24)'
    fn2['parameters'] = fn2p

    const fn3p: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn3p['type'] = 'object'
    const fn3: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn3['name'] = 'session_info'
    fn3['description'] = '获取当前终端会话信息(类型/状态/连接标签)'
    fn3['parameters'] = fn3p

    const p4: Record<string, Object> = {}
    const p4p: Record<string, Object> = {}
    p4p['type'] = 'string'
    p4p['description'] = '远端路径'
    p4['path'] = p4p
    const fn4p: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn4p['type'] = 'object'
    fn4p['properties'] = p4
    const fn4: Record<string, Object> = {}
    fn4['name'] = 'sftp_list'
    fn4['description'] = '列出当前 SSH 会话远端目录内容。path: 远端路径(默认 .)'
    fn4['parameters'] = fn4p

    const mk = (fn: Record<string, Object>): Record<string, Object> => {
      const s: Record<string, Object> = {}
      s['type'] = 'function'
      s['function'] = fn
      return s
    }
    const arr: Record<string, Object>[] = [mk(fn1), mk(fn2), mk(fn3), mk(fn4)]
    return JSON.stringify(arr)
  }

  /** 危险命令黑名单(rm -rf 必中: rm 后跟空白)。 */
  static riskOf(cmd: string): string {

/* ========== 第 4 页 ========== */
    const d = /rm\s|mkfs|dd\s|reboot|shutdown|kill|chmod|chown|>\s*\/|curl.*\|\s*sh|wget.*\|\s*sh/
    if (d.test(cmd)) {
      return 'dangerous'
    }
    const r = /^(ls|cat|pwd|whoami|uname|df|free|ps|ip|ifconfig|netstat|uptime|top|head|tail|grep|echo|date|id)\b/
    if (r.test(cmd)) {
      return 'read'
    }
    return 'write'
  }

  /** 审批门: 全部确认→true; 仅危险→risk==='dangerous'; 全自动→false。 */
  static needConfirm(mode: ApprovalMode, risk: string): boolean {
    if (mode === 'confirm_all') {
      return true
    }
    if (mode === 'confirm_dangerous') {
      return risk === 'dangerous'
    }
    return false
  }

  /** 入口: 用户指令 → 多轮回路。 */
  static async run(userText: string): Promise<void> {
    if (AgentKernel.busy) {
      hilog.warn(DOMAIN, TAG, 'busy, ignore new run')
      return
    }
    AgentKernel.busy = true
    AgentKernel.round = 0
    AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'user', text: userText, name: '', args: '', result: '', callId: '', round: 0 })
    try {
      const filesDir = AppStorage.get<string>('ut.filesDir') ?? ''
      const cfg: LlmConfig = LlmConfigStore.read(filesDir)
      if (cfg.apiKey === '') {
        AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'err', text: '未配置模型(设置→AI 模型)', name: '', args: '', result: '', callId: '', round: 0 })
        return
      }
      const settings = AgentSettingsStore.read(filesDir)
      hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'run mode=%{public}s rounds<=12', settings.mode)
      const system = '你是一站AI终端的智能体。可用工具: term_write(执行shell命令,危险命令需用户审批)、' +
        'term_read(读终端屏幕)、session_info(会话信息)、sftp_list(列远端目录)。' +
        '完成用户任务时优先用工具,所有命令必须经 term_write 执行;' +
        '执行后用 term_read 查看输出再决定下一步;完成后直接文字答复,不再调用工具。'
      const hist: LlmMsg[] = []
      const userMsg = new LlmMsg()
      userMsg.role = 'user'
      userMsg.text = userText
      hist.push(userMsg)
      let final = ''

/* ========== 第 5 页 ========== */
      for (let r = 1; r <= MAX_ROUNDS; r++) {
        AgentKernel.round = r
        AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'round', text: '', name: '', args: '', result: '', callId: '', round: r })
        const res = await Llm.chatWithTools(cfg, AgentKernel.trimHistory(hist), system, AgentKernel.toolsJson())
        hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'round %{public}d finish=%{public}s calls=%{public}s',
          r, res.finishReason, res.toolCallsJson.substring(0, 120))
        if (res.toolCallsJson === '[]' || res.toolCallsJson === '') {
          final = res.content
          break
        }
        // assistant 轮回填(tool_calls)
        const am = new LlmMsg()
        am.role = 'assistant'
        am.text = res.content
        am.toolCallsJson = res.toolCallsJson
        hist.push(am)
        const calls = JSON.parse(res.toolCallsJson) as OaiToolCall[]
        for (const tc of calls) {
          const outcome = await AgentKernel.handleToolCall(tc, settings.mode, r)
          // role:tool 回填
          const tm = new LlmMsg()
          tm.role = 'tool'
          tm.toolCallId = tc.id
          tm.text = outcome
          hist.push(tm)
        }
      }
      if (final === '') {
        final = '已达最大轮次(12),任务暂停。可继续发送指令续跑。'
      }
      AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'done', text: final, name: '', args: '', result: '', callId: '', round: AgentKernel.round })
      AgentKernel.audit(0, 'run', userText.substring(0, 200), true, true, final.substring(0, 200))
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : JSON.stringify(e)
      hilog.error(DOMAIN, TAG, 'run FAIL %{public}s', msg)
      AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'err', text: '执行失败: ' + msg, name: '', args: '', result: '', callId: '', round: AgentKernel.round })
    } finally {
      AgentKernel.busy = false
    }
  }

  /** 单个 tool_call: 审批门 → 执行 → 返回工具结果文本。 */
  private static async handleToolCall(tc: OaiToolCall, mode: ApprovalMode, round: number): Promise<string> {
    let args: string = ''
    if (tc.name === 'term_write') {
      args = AgentKernel.argString(tc.arguments, 'cmd')
    } else if (tc.name === 'term_read') {
      args = AgentKernel.argString(tc.arguments, 'lastN')
    } else if (tc.name === 'sftp_list') {
      args = AgentKernel.argString(tc.arguments, 'path')

/* ========== 第 6 页 ========== */
    } else if (tc.name === 'session_info') {
      args = ''
    } else {
      AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'tool', text: '', name: tc.name, args: tc.arguments, result: '未知工具: ' + tc.name, callId: tc.id, round: round })
      return '未知工具: ' + tc.name
    }
    // 审批门
    if (tc.name === 'term_write') {
      const risk = AgentKernel.riskOf(args)
      if (AgentKernel.needConfirm(mode, risk)) {
        const ok = await AgentKernel.requestApproval(tc.id, tc.name, args, round)
        if (!ok) {
          const denied = '用户拒绝执行该命令。'
          AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'tool', text: '', name: tc.name, args: args, result: denied, callId: tc.id, round: round })
          AgentKernel.audit(round, tc.name, args, false, false, denied)
          return denied
        }
      }
    }
    // 执行
    let out = ''
    let ok = true
    try {
      if (tc.name === 'term_write') {
        out = await AgentKernel.termWrite(args)
      } else if (tc.name === 'term_read') {
        out = AgentKernel.termRead(tc.arguments)
      } else if (tc.name === 'session_info') {
        out = AgentKernel.sessionInfo()
      } else if (tc.name === 'sftp_list') {
        out = await AgentKernel.sftpList(args)
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ok = false
      out = '工具执行异常: ' + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : JSON.stringify(e))
    }
    AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'tool', text: '', name: tc.name, args: args, result: out, callId: tc.id, round: round })
    AgentKernel.audit(round, tc.name, args, ok, true, out)
    return out
  }

  /** 挂起等待 UI 审批(Promise 不落地不推进)。 */
  private static requestApproval(callId: string, name: string, args: string, round: number): Promise<boolean> {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      AgentKernel.pendingResolve = resolve
      AgentKernel.pendingCallId = callId
      AgentKernel.emit({ kind: 'need_approval', text: '', name: name, args: args, result: '', callId: callId, round: round })
      hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'need_approval callId=%{public}s cmd=%{public}s', callId, args)
    })
  }

/* ========== 第 7 页 ========== */

  /** term_write: 写入命令 → 屏幕指纹轮询等输出稳定 → 返回增量输出。 */
  private static async termWrite(cmd: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!SessionService.hasSession()) {
      return '无活动终端会话'
    }
    const before = SessionService.screenText(4000)
    const n = SessionService.write(cmd + '\n')
    if (n < 0) {
      return '命令写入失败'
    }
    // 屏幕指纹对比轮询(上限 8s): 文本稳定 1.2s 或命中提示符即收
    return await AgentKernel.waitScreen(before, 8000)
  }

  /** 轮询屏幕文本直到稳定(与 before 不同且连续两次采样一致)。 */
  private static async waitScreen(before: string, maxMs: number): Promise<string> {
    const t0 = Date.now()
    let last = ''
    let stable = 0
    while (Date.now() - t0 < maxMs) {
      await AgentKernel.sleep(400)
      const cur = SessionService.screenText(4000)
      if (cur !== before && cur === last) {
        stable++
        if (stable >= 2) {
          return cur
        }
      } else {
        stable = 0
      }
      last = cur
      // 提示符回落启发: 新行以 $/#/❯ 结尾且长度>4 → 已回到 shell
      const lines = cur.split('\n')
      const lastLine = lines.length > 0 ? lines[lines.length - 2] : ''
      if (cur !== before && lastLine !== '' && /[$#❯]\s*$/.test(lastLine)) {
        return cur
      }
    }
    return last
  }

  /** term_read: 屏幕末 lastN 行(≤40)。 */
  private static termRead(argsJson: string): string {
    let n = 24
    try {
      const o = JSON.parse(argsJson) as Record<string, Object>
      const v = o['lastN']
      if (typeof v === 'number') {
        n = v as number

/* ========== 第 8 页 ========== */
      }
    } catch (e) {
    }
    if (n < 1) {
      n = 1
    }
    if (n > 40) {
      n = 40
    }
    return SessionService.screenText(4000).split('\n').slice(-n).join('\n')
  }

  /** session_info: 会话状态快照。 */
  private static sessionInfo(): string {
    const status = AppStorage.get<string>('ut.term.status') ?? 'unknown'
    const title = AppStorage.get<string>('ut.term.title') ?? ''
    return JSON.stringify({ status: status, title: title, hasSession: SessionService.hasSession(), sessionId: SessionService.getSessionId() })
  }

  /** sftp_list: 列远端目录(复用活动 SSH 会话)。 */
  private static async sftpList(path: string): Promise<string> {
    const ssh = SessionService.sshHandle()
    const sid = SessionService.getSessionId()
    if (ssh === null || sid < 0) {
      return '无活动 SSH 会话'
    }
    const json = await ssh.sftpList(sid, path === '' ? '.' : path)
    return json.substring(0, 3000)
  }

  /** 历史预算: >MAX_HISTORY 条消息截断中间(保头尾)。 */
  private static trimHistory(hist: LlmMsg[]): LlmMsg[] {
    if (hist.length <= MAX_HISTORY) {
      return hist
    }
    const head = hist.slice(0, 2)
    const tail = hist.slice(hist.length - (MAX_HISTORY - 2))
    return head.concat(tail)
    // 注: 中间被截断,模型可能看不到早期上下文;预算换 token 安全。
  }

  private static argString(argsJson: string, key: string): string {
    try {
      const o = JSON.parse(argsJson) as Record<string, Object>
      const v = o[key]
      if (typeof v === 'string') {
        return v
      }
      if (typeof v === 'number') {
        return (v as number).toString()

/* ========== 第 9 页 ========== */
      }
    } catch (e) {
    }
    return ''
  }

  /** 审计: append 一行 jsonl(filesDir/agent-audit.jsonl)。 */
  private static audit(round: number, tool: string, args: string, ok: boolean, approved: boolean, result: string): void {
    try {
      const filesDir = AppStorage.get<string>('ut.filesDir') ?? ''
      if (filesDir === '') {
        return
      }
      const row: AuditRow = {
        ts: Date.now(), round: round, tool: tool, args: args,
        ok: ok, approved: approved, result: result.substring(0, 300)
      }
      const p = filesDir + '/agent-audit.jsonl'
      let f: fs.File | null = null
      try {
        f = fs.openSync(p, fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fs.OpenMode.CREATE | fs.OpenMode.APPEND)
        fs.writeSync(f.fd, JSON.stringify(row) + '\n')
        fs.closeSync(f)
      } catch (e) {
        if (f !== null) {
          try {
            fs.closeSync(f)
          } catch (e2) {
          }
        }
        hilog.warn(DOMAIN, TAG, 'audit append fail %{public}s', JSON.stringify(e))
      }
    } catch (e) {
    }
  }

  private static emit(e: KernelEvent): void {
    AgentKernel.onEvent(e)
  }

  private static sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms))
  }
}


// ===== 文件: HarnessClient.ets (234 行) =====
// M6 relay5 - hmharness Web 直连(模式B):纯网络层,不碰 ArkUI。
// 协议(实勘 G:\hmharness\packages\web):
//   POST {base}/api/task   body {text,mode} -> 200 入队/开跑

/* ========== 第 10 页 ========== */
//   GET  {base}/api/events SSE(text/event-stream,事件带 id,支持 Last-Event-ID 补发)
//   GET  {base}/api/state  连接测试端点
// 流式: @ohos.net.http HttpRequest.requestInStream + on('dataReceive')/on('dataEnd')
//   —— SDK d.ts 实证(SDK 默认 openharmony ets api)支持,无需降级轮询。
// 事件名与载荷(JSON):
//   hello|busy|line|delta|tool|toolResult|approvalReq|approvalDone|final|error|injected|queue|state
// hilog tag: oat.harness(域 0x0111)
import http from '@ohos.net.http';
import hilog from '@ohos.hilog';

const HS_TAG: string = 'oat.harness';
const HS_DOMAIN: number = 0x0111;

/** SSE 事件分发回调(事件名 -> data JSON 解析失败时给出原文)。 */
export interface HarnessEventCbs {
  onEvent: (name: string, data: string) => void
  onError: (msg: string) => void
  onEnd: () => void
}

/** 单条已解析 SSE 消息(事件名+data,可能多行 data: 合并)。 */
class SseMsg {
  name: string = ''
  data: string = ''
}

/**
 * HarnessStream - 一条到 {base}/api/events 的 SSE 流 + /api/task 发任务。
 * 用法: connect(cbs) 建流 -> send(task,mode) 发任务 -> close()。
 * 内部: dataReceive 字节缓冲,按 \n 切行;空行=一条消息边界;
 * 行形如 "event: xxx" / "data: {...}";事件 id 记录(断线重连 Last-Event-ID)。
 */
export class HarnessStream {
  private req: http.HttpRequest | null = null
  private buffer: string = ''
  private curEvent: string = ''
  private curData: string = ''
  private lastId: number = -1
  private base: string = ''
  private cbs: HarnessEventCbs | null = null
  private closed: boolean = false

  constructor(base: string) {
    this.base = base.replace(/\/+$/, '')
  }

  /** 建立 SSE 长连接(GET /api/events, Accept: text/event-stream)。 */
  connect(cbs: HarnessEventCbs): void {
    this.cbs = cbs
    this.closed = false

/* ========== 第 11 页 ========== */
    this.req = http.createHttp()
    this.req.on('dataReceive', (buf: ArrayBuffer) => {
      this.onBytes(buf)
    })
    this.req.on('dataEnd', () => {
      hilog.info(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'stream dataEnd lastId=%{public}d', this.lastId)
      this.emitMessage()
      if (this.cbs !== null) {
        this.cbs.onEnd()
      }
    })
    const opts: http.HttpRequestOptions = {
      method: http.RequestMethod.GET,
      header: { 'Accept': 'text/event-stream', 'Last-Event-ID': this.lastId.toString() },
      connectTimeout: 15000,
      readTimeout: 600000
    }
    this.req.requestInStream(this.base + '/api/events', opts, (err: Error, code: number) => {
      if (err !== undefined && err !== null && err.message !== '') {
        hilog.error(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'stream start fail err=%{public}s', JSON.stringify(err))
        if (this.cbs !== null) {
          this.cbs.onError('连接失败: ' + JSON.stringify(err).substring(0, 120))
        }
        return
      }
      if (code !== 200) {
        hilog.error(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'stream start code=%{public}d', code)
        if (this.cbs !== null) {
          this.cbs.onError('服务返回 ' + code)
        }
        return
      }
      hilog.info(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'stream opened base=%{public}s', this.base)
    })
  }

  private onBytes(buf: ArrayBuffer): void {
    this.buffer += this.buf2str(buf)
    // 逐行处理,末行可能不完整留在 buffer
    let nl = this.buffer.indexOf('\n')
    while (nl >= 0) {
      const line = this.buffer.substring(0, nl)
      this.buffer = this.buffer.substring(nl + 1)
      this.onLine(line)
      nl = this.buffer.indexOf('\n')
    }
  }

  private onLine(raw: string): void {
    const line = raw.replace(/\r$/, '')

/* ========== 第 12 页 ========== */
    if (line === '') {
      // 空行=一条消息结束
      this.emitMessage()
      return
    }
    if (line.startsWith('event:')) {
      this.curEvent = line.substring(6).trim()
    } else if (line.startsWith('data:')) {
      const d = line.substring(5)
      this.curData = this.curData === '' ? d : this.curData + '\n' + d
    } else if (line.startsWith('id:')) {
      const idStr = line.substring(3).trim()
      const n = Number(idStr)
      if (!isNaN(n)) {
        this.lastId = n
      }
    }
  }

  private emitMessage(): void {
    if (this.curEvent === '' && this.curData === '') {
      return
    }
    const cbs = this.cbs
    if (cbs !== null) {
      cbs.onEvent(this.curEvent, this.curData)
    }
    this.curEvent = ''
    this.curData = ''
  }

  private buf2str(buf: ArrayBuffer): string {
    const u8 = new Uint8Array(buf)
    let out = ''
    for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) {
      out += String.fromCharCode(u8[i])
    }
    return out
  }

  /** 发任务: POST /api/task {text,mode}。失败时经 cbs.onError 上抛。 */
  send(task: string, mode: string): void {
    const bodyObj: Record<string, string> = {}
    bodyObj['text'] = task
    bodyObj['mode'] = mode
    bodyObj['fresh'] = 'true'
    const p = this.base + '/api/task'
    const r = http.createHttp()
    r.request(p, {
      method: http.RequestMethod.POST,

/* ========== 第 13 页 ========== */
      header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      extraData: JSON.stringify(bodyObj),
      connectTimeout: 15000,
      readTimeout: 30000
    }, (err: Error, resp: http.HttpResponse) => {
      if (err !== undefined && err !== null && err.message !== '') {
        hilog.error(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'task send fail err=%{public}s', JSON.stringify(err))
        if (this.cbs !== null) {
          this.cbs.onError('任务发送失败: ' + JSON.stringify(err).substring(0, 120))
        }
        return
      }
      if (resp.responseCode !== 200) {
        hilog.error(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'task send code=%{public}d', resp.responseCode)
        if (this.cbs !== null) {
          this.cbs.onError('服务返回 ' + resp.responseCode + '(busy/入队?看事件流)')
        }
        return
      }
      hilog.info(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'task sent len=%{public}d mode=%{public}s', task.length, mode)
    })
  }

  close(): void {
    this.closed = true
    this.cbs = null
    const r = this.req
    this.req = null
    if (r !== null) {
      try {
        r.destroy()
      } catch (e) {
      }
    }
    hilog.info(HS_DOMAIN, HS_TAG, 'stream closed')
  }

  get isClosed(): boolean {
    return this.closed
  }
}

/** 连接测试结果。 */
export interface HarnessTestResult {
  ok: boolean
  detail: string
}

export class HarnessClient {
  /** 连接测试: GET {base}/api/state,断言 200 且 json.model 存在即在线。 */

/* ========== 第 14 页 ========== */
  static test(base: string): Promise<HarnessTestResult> {
    return new Promise<HarnessTestResult>((resolve) => {
      const r = http.createHttp()
      r.request(base.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/api/state', {
        method: http.RequestMethod.GET,
        connectTimeout: 8000,
        readTimeout: 8000
      }, (err: Error, resp: http.HttpResponse) => {
        if (err !== undefined && err !== null && err.message !== '') {
          resolve({ ok: false, detail: '不可达: ' + JSON.stringify(err).substring(0, 80) })
          return
        }
        if (resp.responseCode !== 200) {
          resolve({ ok: false, detail: '返回 ' + resp.responseCode })
          return
        }
        try {
          const obj = JSON.parse(resp.result as string) as Record<string, string>
          if (obj['model'] !== undefined) {
            resolve({ ok: true, detail: '在线 model=' + obj['model'] })
          } else {
            resolve({ ok: false, detail: '响应无 model 字段' })
          }
        } catch (e) {
          resolve({ ok: false, detail: '响应解析失败' })
        }
      })
    })
  }
}


// ===== 文件: Llm.ets (213 行) =====
// LLM 接入:官方兼容 Anthropic / OpenAI 协议(设置中配 base URL + key + model)
// M6 relay3: chatWithTools 支持 OpenAI 兼容 function-calling(tools 参数 +
// assistant tool_calls 回传 + role:tool 结果回填),供 AgentKernel 多轮驱动。
import http from '@ohos.net.http';

export class LlmConfig {
  provider: string = 'anthropic'
  baseUrl: string = 'https://api.anthropic.com'
  apiKey: string = ''
  model: string = 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
  /** M6 relay5: 增强模式 hmharness 服务地址(空=未启用) */
  harnessUrl: string = ''
}

export class LlmMsg {
  role: string = 'user'
  text: string = ''

/* ========== 第 15 页 ========== */
  /** M6 relay3: assistant 轮的 tool_calls JSON(OaiToolCall[] 序列化,空串=无) */
  toolCallsJson: string = ''
  /** M6 relay3: role='tool' 轮对应的 tool_call id */
  toolCallId: string = ''
}

/** chatWithTools 的单个 tool_call(拍平 OpenAI 的 function.name/arguments)。 */
export class OaiToolCall {
  id: string = ''
  type: string = 'function'
  name: string = ''
  arguments: string = ''
}

/** chatWithTools 结果。 */
export class ToolCallResult {
  content: string = ''
  toolCallsJson: string = '[]'
  finishReason: string = ''
  raw: string = ''
}

class AnthMsg {
  role: string = 'user'
  content: string = ''
}

class AnthBody {
  model: string = ''
  max_tokens: number = 1024
  system: string = ''
  messages: AnthMsg[] = []
}

export class Llm {
  static async chat(cfg: LlmConfig, msgs: LlmMsg[], system: string): Promise<string> {
    if (cfg.provider === 'anthropic') {
      return Llm.anthropic(cfg, msgs, system)
    }
    const r = await Llm.openaiChat(cfg, msgs, system, null)
    return r.content
  }

  /**
   * M6 relay3: OpenAI 兼容 function-calling 一轮调用。
   * - msgs 中 role='assistant' 且 toolCallsJson 非空 → 序列化为 tool_calls 轮(content 兼容空)
   * - role='tool' → {role, tool_call_id, content}
   * - toolsJson: OpenAI tools 数组 JSON;null=不带 tools(普通 chat)
   */
  static async chatWithTools(cfg: LlmConfig, msgs: LlmMsg[], system: string, toolsJson: string | null): Promise<ToolCallResult> {

/* ========== 第 16 页 ========== */
    if (cfg.provider === 'anthropic') {
      throw new Error('function-calling 暂不支持 anthropic,请在设置中切换 OpenAI 兼容 provider')
    }
    return Llm.openaiChat(cfg, msgs, system, toolsJson)
  }

  private static async anthropic(cfg: LlmConfig, msgs: LlmMsg[], system: string): Promise<string> {
    const body = new AnthBody()
    body.model = cfg.model
    body.system = system
    for (const m of msgs) {
      const a = new AnthMsg()
      a.role = m.role
      a.content = m.text
      body.messages.push(a)
    }
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'x-api-key': cfg.apiKey,
      'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
    }
    const resp = await Llm.post(cfg.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/v1/messages', JSON.stringify(body), headers)
    class AnthPart { type: string = ''; text: string = '' }
    class AnthResp { content: AnthPart[] = [] }
    const obj = JSON.parse(resp) as AnthResp
    if (obj.content.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('anthropic bad resp: ' + resp.substring(0, 200))
    }
    let out = ''
    for (const p of obj.content) {
      if (p.type === 'text') {
        out += p.text
      }
    }
    return out
  }

  private static async openaiChat(cfg: LlmConfig, msgs: LlmMsg[], system: string, toolsJson: string | null): Promise<ToolCallResult> {
    // 请求体用 Record 组装:assistant tool_calls 轮与 role:tool 轮需精确字段名
    const msgsRec: Record<string, Object>[] = []
    const sysRec: Record<string, Object> = {}
    sysRec['role'] = 'system'
    sysRec['content'] = system
    msgsRec.push(sysRec)
    for (const m of msgs) {
      const r: Record<string, Object> = {}
      r['role'] = m.role
      if (m.role === 'tool') {
        r['tool_call_id'] = m.toolCallId
        r['content'] = m.text

/* ========== 第 17 页 ========== */
      } else if (m.role === 'assistant' && m.toolCallsJson !== '') {
        r['content'] = m.text
        const tcs = JSON.parse(m.toolCallsJson) as OaiToolCall[]
        const arr: Record<string, Object>[] = []
        for (const t of tcs) {
          const fn: Record<string, Object> = {}
          fn['name'] = t.name
          fn['arguments'] = t.arguments
          const tc: Record<string, Object> = {}
          tc['id'] = t.id
          tc['type'] = t.type
          tc['function'] = fn
          arr.push(tc)
        }
        r['tool_calls'] = arr
      } else {
        r['content'] = m.text
      }
      msgsRec.push(r)
    }
    const body: Record<string, Object> = {}
    body['model'] = cfg.model
    body['max_tokens'] = 1024
    body['messages'] = msgsRec
    if (toolsJson !== null) {
      body['tools'] = JSON.parse(toolsJson) as Object
      const choice: Record<string, Object> = {}
      choice['type'] = 'auto'
      body['tool_choice'] = choice
    }
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + cfg.apiKey
    }
    const resp = await Llm.post(cfg.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/chat/completions', JSON.stringify(body), headers)
    class OaiFnOut { name: string = ''; arguments: string = '' }
    class OaiToolCallOut { id: string = ''; type: string = ''; function: OaiFnOut = new OaiFnOut() }
    class OaiMsgOut { content: string | null = null; tool_calls: OaiToolCallOut[] | null = null }
    class OaiChoice { message: OaiMsgOut = new OaiMsgOut(); finish_reason: string = '' }
    class OaiResp { choices: OaiChoice[] = [] }
    const obj = JSON.parse(resp) as OaiResp
    if (obj.choices.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('openai bad resp: ' + resp.substring(0, 200))
    }
    const c0 = obj.choices[0]
    const out = new ToolCallResult()
    out.finishReason = c0.finish_reason
    out.raw = resp
    if (c0.message.content !== null && c0.message.content !== undefined) {
      out.content = c0.message.content

/* ========== 第 18 页 ========== */
    }
    const tcs: OaiToolCall[] = []
    if (c0.message.tool_calls !== null && c0.message.tool_calls !== undefined) {
      for (const t of c0.message.tool_calls) {
        const tc = new OaiToolCall()
        tc.id = t.id
        tc.type = t.type
        tc.name = t.function.name
        tc.arguments = t.function.arguments
        tcs.push(tc)
      }
    }
    out.toolCallsJson = JSON.stringify(tcs)
    return out
  }

  private static async post(url: string, body: string, headers: Record<string, string>): Promise<string> {
    return new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
      const h = http.createHttp()
      h.request(url, {
        method: http.RequestMethod.POST,
        header: headers,
        extraData: body,
        connectTimeout: 30000,
        readTimeout: 60000,
        expectDataType: http.HttpDataType.STRING
      }, (err, resp) => {
        h.destroy()
        if (err) {
          reject(new Error('http ' + JSON.stringify(err)))
          return
        }
        if (resp.responseCode >= 400) {
          let d = ''
          if (typeof resp.result === 'string') {
            d = resp.result
          }
          reject(new Error('http ' + resp.responseCode + ' ' + d.substring(0, 300)))
          return
        }
        resolve(typeof resp.result === 'string' ? resp.result : '')
      })
    })
  }
}


// ===== 文件: AIDock.ets (597 行) =====
/**
 * M6 relay3 - AI 智能体 Dock(底部可折叠工作坞)。

/* ========== 第 19 页 ========== */
 * 展开态 ~320px: Dock 头(输入行 + 模式三档切换 + 轮次指示 R1/12 + 折叠钮) +
 * 消息流(用户气泡/AI 气泡/工具卡三类; 工具卡=命令+结果摘要+审批按钮 允许/拒绝)。
 * 折叠态 28px 细条。复用 LlmConfigStore 配置 + AgentSettingsStore 三档。
 * 主题经 @StorageProp('ut.theme') 接入(relay1 P0-4 范式)。
 */
import { common } from '@kit.AbilityKit';
import { AppTheme, themeByName } from '../common/AppTheme';
import { AgentKernel, KernelEvent } from '../service/AgentKernel';
import { AgentSettings, AgentSettingsStore, ApprovalMode } from '../service/AgentSettingsStore';
import { LlmConfigStore } from '../service/LlmConfigStore';
import { HarnessStream, HarnessEventCbs } from '../service/HarnessClient';
import hilog from '@ohos.hilog';

const HS_TAG: string = 'oat.dock';

/** Dock 消息条目(三类: user/assistant/tool + 审批态)。 */
class DockMsg {
  kind: string = 'user' // 'user' | 'assistant' | 'tool'
  text: string = ''
  name: string = ''
  args: string = ''
  result: string = ''
  callId: string = ''
  pending: boolean = false // 工具卡待审批(显示允许/拒绝按钮)
  refused: boolean = false
  // M6 relay5: 增强模式(hmharness SSE)标记
  harnessNote: string = '' // 增强模式卡片附注(等待宿主审批/结果摘要/中断提示)
  harnessDone: boolean = false // 增强模式结果已回填
}

@Component
export struct AIDock {
  @StorageProp('ut.theme') themeName: string = 'dark'
  @State open: boolean = false
  @State input: string = ''
  @State msgs: DockMsg[] = []
  @State mode: ApprovalMode = 'confirm_all'
  @State round: number = 0
  @State running: boolean = false
  @State approvalPending: boolean = false
  @State msgSeq: number = 0
  // M6 relay5: 双引擎(内置内核 / 增强模式 hmharness 直连)
  @State enhanced: boolean = false
  private hStream: HarnessStream | null = null
  private hAssistant: DockMsg | null = null
  private hToolMsgs: DockMsg[] = []
  private hPendingApproval: DockMsg | null = null
  private lastTask: string = ''
  private scroller: Scroller = new Scroller()
  private filesDir: string = ''

/* ========== 第 20 页 ========== */
  private modeNames: string[] = ['全部确认', '仅危险', '全自动']
  private modeVals: ApprovalMode[] = ['confirm_all', 'confirm_dangerous', 'bypass']

  private th(): AppTheme {
    return themeByName(this.themeName)
  }

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    const ctx = getContext(this) as common.UIAbilityContext
    this.filesDir = ctx.filesDir
    const s = AgentSettingsStore.read(this.filesDir)
    this.mode = s.mode
    AgentKernel.onEvent = (e: KernelEvent): void => {
      this.onKernelEvent(e)
    }
  }

  aboutToDisappear(): void {
    AgentKernel.onEvent = (e: KernelEvent): void => {
    }
    this.closeHarness()
  }

  private closeHarness(): void {
    const st = this.hStream
    this.hStream = null
    if (st !== null) {
      st.close()
    }
    this.hAssistant = null
    this.hToolMsgs = []
    this.hPendingApproval = null
  }

  private pushMsg(m: DockMsg): void {
    this.msgSeq++
    this.msgs.push(m)
  }

  private onKernelEvent(e: KernelEvent): void {
    if (e.kind === 'user') {
      const m = new DockMsg()
      m.kind = 'user'
      m.text = e.text
      this.pushMsg(m)
    } else if (e.kind === 'assistant' || e.kind === 'done') {
      const m = new DockMsg()
      m.kind = 'assistant'
      m.text = e.text
      this.pushMsg(m)

/* ========== 第 21 页 ========== */
    } else if (e.kind === 'tool') {
      const m = new DockMsg()
      m.kind = 'tool'
      m.name = e.name
      m.args = e.args
      m.result = e.result
      m.callId = e.callId
      this.pushMsg(m)
    } else if (e.kind === 'need_approval') {
      const m = new DockMsg()
      m.kind = 'tool'
      m.name = e.name
      m.args = e.args
      m.callId = e.callId
      m.pending = true
      this.pushMsg(m)
      this.approvalPending = true
    } else if (e.kind === 'round') {
      this.round = e.round
    } else if (e.kind === 'err') {
      const m = new DockMsg()
      m.kind = 'assistant'
      m.text = e.text
      this.pushMsg(m)
    }
    this.scrollBottom()
  }

  private scrollBottom(): void {
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.scroller.scrollEdge(Edge.Bottom)
    }, 50)
  }

  private send(): void {
    const t = this.input.trim()
    if (t === '' || this.running) {
      return
    }
    this.input = ''
    this.lastTask = t
    this.running = true
    if (this.enhanced) {
      this.sendEnhanced(t)
      return
    }
    AgentKernel.run(t).then(() => {
      this.running = false
    }).catch((e: Object) => {
      this.running = false

/* ========== 第 22 页 ========== */
    })
  }

  // ===== M6 relay5: 增强模式(hm harness 直连) =====
  private sendEnhanced(task: string): void {
    const cfg = LlmConfigStore.read(this.filesDir)
    const url = cfg.harnessUrl === undefined ? '' : cfg.harnessUrl
    if (url === '') {
      this.pushHarnessError('未配置增强模式服务地址(设置→AI 模型→增强模式)')
      this.running = false
      return
    }
    const m = new DockMsg()
    m.kind = 'user'
    m.text = task
    this.pushMsg(m)
    const st = new HarnessStream(url)
    this.hStream = st
    // 流式 assistant 气泡(打字机追加 line/delta)
    const ab = new DockMsg()
    ab.kind = 'assistant'
    ab.text = ''
    this.hAssistant = ab
    const cbs: HarnessEventCbs = {
      onEvent: (name: string, data: string): void => {
        this.onHarnessEvent(name, data)
      },
      onError: (msg: string): void => {
        this.onHarnessError(msg)
      },
      onEnd: (): void => {
        this.onHarnessEnd()
      }
    }
    st.connect(cbs)
    st.send(task, 'default')
  }

  private onHarnessEvent(name: string, data: string): void {
    let obj: Record<string, string> = {}
    try {
      obj = JSON.parse(data) as Record<string, string>
    } catch (e) {
      obj = {}
    }
    if (name === 'line') {
      const ab = this.hAssistant
      if (ab !== null) {
        ab.text = ab.text === '' ? (obj['text'] === undefined ? '' : obj['text']) : ab.text + '\n' + (obj['text'] === undefined ? '' : obj['text'])
        // 首次有内容时入消息流

/* ========== 第 23 页 ========== */
        if (this.msgs.indexOf(ab) < 0 && ab.text !== '') {
          this.pushMsg(ab)
        }
      }
      this.scrollBottom()
    } else if (name === 'delta') {
      const ab = this.hAssistant
      if (ab !== null) {
        const chunk = obj['chunk'] === undefined ? '' : obj['chunk']
        ab.text = ab.text + chunk
        if (this.msgs.indexOf(ab) < 0 && ab.text !== '') {
          this.pushMsg(ab)
        }
      }
      this.scrollBottom()
    } else if (name === 'tool') {
      const cm = new DockMsg()
      cm.kind = 'tool'
      cm.name = obj['name'] === undefined ? 'tool' : obj['name']
      cm.args = obj['args'] === undefined ? '' : obj['args'].toString().substring(0, 160)
      this.pushMsg(cm)
      this.hToolMsgs.push(cm)
      this.scrollBottom()
    } else if (name === 'toolResult') {
      const last = this.hToolMsgs.length > 0 ? this.hToolMsgs[this.hToolMsgs.length - 1] : null
      if (last !== null) {
        last.harnessDone = true
        const err = obj['isError'] === undefined ? false : obj['isError'] === 'true'
        last.result = err ? '✗ ' + (obj['preview'] === undefined ? '' : obj['preview'].toString().substring(0, 200))
          : '✓ ' + (obj['preview'] === undefined ? '' : obj['preview'].toString().substring(0, 200))
      }
      this.scrollBottom()
    } else if (name === 'approvalReq') {
      const am = new DockMsg()
      am.kind = 'tool'
      am.name = obj['name'] === undefined ? 'approval' : obj['name']
      am.args = obj['args'] === undefined ? '' : obj['args'].toString().substring(0, 160)
      am.harnessNote = '⚠ hmharness 等待宿主审批(web UI 决定), 5 分钟超时自动拒绝'
      this.pushMsg(am)
      this.hToolMsgs.push(am)
      this.hPendingApproval = am
      this.scrollBottom()
    } else if (name === 'approvalDone') {
      const pa = this.hPendingApproval
      if (pa !== null) {
        const granted = obj['granted'] === undefined ? false : obj['granted'] === 'true'
        pa.harnessDone = true
        pa.harnessNote = granted ? '✓ 宿主已批准' : '✗ 宿主已拒绝/超时'
      }
      this.hPendingApproval = null

/* ========== 第 24 页 ========== */
      this.scrollBottom()
    } else if (name === 'final') {
      const ab = this.hAssistant
      const full = obj['text'] === undefined ? obj['result'] === undefined ? '' : obj['result'].toString() : obj['text']
      if (ab !== null && full !== '') {
        ab.text = full
      } else if (full !== '') {
        const fm = new DockMsg()
        fm.kind = 'assistant'
        fm.text = full
        this.pushMsg(fm)
      }
      this.finishHarness()
    } else if (name === 'error') {
      const ab = this.hAssistant
      if (ab !== null) {
        ab.text = ab.text === '' ? (obj['message'] === undefined ? '服务报错' : obj['message']) : ab.text + '\n' + (obj['message'] === undefined ? '' : obj['message'])
      }
      this.finishHarness()
    } else if (name === 'busy') {
      const b = obj['busy']
      if (b !== undefined) {
        hilog.info(0x0111, HS_TAG, 'busy=%{public}s', b)
      }
    }
  }

  private onHarnessError(msg: string): void {
    // 连接失败/不可达 -> 回落内置内核
    this.pushHarnessFallback(msg)
  }

  private onHarnessEnd(): void {
    // SSE 流断开: 任务可能仍在宿主跑
    const ab = this.hAssistant
    if (ab !== null && ab.text === '') {
      ab.text = '连接中断, 任务在宿主继续'
      this.pushMsg(ab)
    }
    this.finishHarness()
  }

  private finishHarness(): void {
    this.running = false
    this.closeHarness()
  }

  private pushHarnessError(msg: string): void {
    const m = new DockMsg()
    m.kind = 'assistant'

/* ========== 第 25 页 ========== */
    m.text = msg
    this.pushMsg(m)
    this.scrollBottom()
  }

  private pushHarnessFallback(msg: string): void {
    this.pushHarnessError('服务不可达(' + msg + '), 已回落内置内核')
    this.closeHarness()
    this.enhanced = false
    const t = this.lastTask
    if (t !== '') {
      this.running = true
      AgentKernel.run(t).then(() => {
        this.running = false
      }).catch((e: Object) => {
        this.running = false
      })
    }
  }


  private setMode(m: ApprovalMode): void {
    this.mode = m
    const s = new AgentSettings()
    s.mode = m
    AgentSettingsStore.write(this.filesDir, s)
  }

  private approve(callId: string): void {
    for (const m of this.msgs) {
      if (m.callId === callId && m.pending) {
        m.pending = false
      }
    }
    this.approvalPending = false
    AgentKernel.approve()
  }

  private deny(callId: string): void {
    for (const m of this.msgs) {
      if (m.callId === callId && m.pending) {
        m.pending = false
        m.refused = true
        m.result = '已拒绝执行'
      }
    }
    this.approvalPending = false
    AgentKernel.deny()
  }


/* ========== 第 26 页 ========== */
  @Builder
  ModePill(label: string, idx: number) {
    Text(label)
      .fontSize(10)
      .fontColor(this.mode === this.modeVals[idx] ? this.th().surface : this.th().inkSubtle)
      .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 3, bottom: 3 })
      .borderRadius(9)
      .border({ width: 1, color: this.mode === this.modeVals[idx] ? this.th().brand : this.th().hairline })
      .backgroundColor(this.mode === this.modeVals[idx] ? this.th().brand : Color.Transparent)
      .margin({ left: 4 })
      .onClick(() => this.setMode(this.modeVals[idx]))
  }

  @Builder

    Text('增强')
      .fontSize(10)
      .fontColor(this.enhanced ? this.th().surface : this.th().inkSubtle)
      .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 3, bottom: 3 })
      .borderRadius(9)
      .border({ width: 1, color: this.enhanced ? this.th().success : this.th().hairline })
      .backgroundColor(this.enhanced ? this.th().success : Color.Transparent)
      .margin({ left: 4 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.enhanced = !this.enhanced
      })
  }

  @Builder
  MsgRow(m: DockMsg) {
    if (m.kind === 'user') {

      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 6, bottom: 2 })
    } else if (m.kind === 'assistant') {
      Row() {
        Text(m.text)
          .fontSize(12)
          .fontColor(this.th().ink)
          .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
          .borderRadius(10)

/* ========== 第 27 页 ========== */

          .border({ width: 1, color: this.th().hairline })

      }
      .width('100%')

    } else {
      // 工具卡: 名称+命令 → 结果摘要 → 审批按钮(待审批时)

            .maxLines(4)

/* ========== 第 28 页 ========== */

            Text('拒绝')
              .fontSize(11)
              .fontColor(this.th().surface)
              .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
              .borderRadius(6)
              .backgroundColor(this.th().danger)
              .onClick(() => this.deny(m.callId))
          }
          .width('100%')
          .justifyContent(FlexAlign.End)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(8)
      .borderRadius(8)
      .backgroundColor(this.th().surfaceRaised)
      .border({ width: 1, color: this.th().hairline })
      .shadow({ radius: 12, color: '#66000000', offsetX: 0, offsetY: 2 })
      .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 4 })
    }
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      if (this.open) {

            .fontColor(this.th().surface)
            .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
            .borderRadius(6)
            .backgroundColor(this.running ? this.th().iconMuted : this.th().brand)
            .onClick(() => this.send())
        }
        .width('100%')

/* ========== 第 30 页 ========== */
        .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 6, bottom: 8 })
        .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
      } else {
        // ===== 折叠态(28px 细条) =====
        Row({ space: 8 }) {
          Text('✦')
            .fontSize(18)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
            .fontColor(this.th().brand)
          Text('智能体')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(this.th().ink)
          if (this.enhanced) {
            Text('增')
              .fontSize(9)
              .fontColor(this.th().success)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          }
          if (this.running) {

              .fontSize(10)
              .fontColor(this.th().brand)
          }
          Blank()

        .onClick(() => {
          this.open = true
        })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(this.open ? 320 : 28)
  }

// PostgreSQL 客户端:wire 协议 v3 纯 TS(@ohos.net.socket + cryptoFramework MD5)
// 子集:startup / cleartext+md5 认证(scram 提示不支持) / 简单查询 Q+T/D/C/E/Z
import socket from '@ohos.net.socket';

/* ========== 第 31 页 ========== */
/* ……(中略)…… */
      }
      const raw = JSON.parse(fileIo.readTextSync(this.metaPath, { encoding: 'utf-8' })) as Record<string, Object>;
      const m = new CredMeta();
      m.mode = (raw['mode'] as string) ?? '';
      m.saltB64 = (raw['salt'] as string) ?? '';
      return m;
    } catch (e) {
      const be = e as Error;
      hilog.error(DOMAIN, TAG, 'readMeta fail %{public}s', JSON.stringify(be.message));
      return null;
    }
  }

  private writeMeta(m: CredMeta): void {
    const obj: Record<string, Object> = {};
    obj['mode'] = m.mode;
    if (m.saltB64.length > 0) {
      obj['salt'] = m.saltB64;
    }
    fileIo.writeSync(fileIo.openSync(this.metaPath,
      fileIo.OpenMode.WRITE_ONLY | fileIo.OpenMode.CREATE | fileIo.OpenMode.TRUNC).fd,
    JSON.stringify(obj));
  }

  /**
   * First-time setup: generate a fresh salt, persist meta, derive the key.
   * Upstream EnableMasterPassword path.
   */
  public async setupMasterPassword(password: string): Promise<void> {
    if (password.length === 0) {
      throw new CredError('master password must not be empty');
    }
    const salt = generateSalt();
    const m = new CredMeta();
    m.mode = 'master-password';
    m.saltB64 = b64u(salt);
    this.writeMeta(m);
    this.meta = m;
    this.key = await deriveKeyPbkdf2(password, salt);
    this.fireUnlock();
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'master password set (mode=master-password)');
  }

  /**
   * Unlock with an existing master password. Wrong password is detected
   * lazily at decrypt time (upstream semantics: no verifier blob on disk).
   * Returns true when a key was derived.
   */
  public async unlock(password: string): Promise<boolean> {

/* ========== 第 32 页 ========== */
    if (!this.hasMasterPassword()) {
      throw new CredError('no master password configured');
    }
    const salt = b64d(this.meta!.saltB64);
    if (salt === null) {
      throw new CredError('credentials.meta has no salt');
    }
    this.key = await deriveKeyPbkdf2(password, salt);
    this.fireUnlock();
    return true;
  }

  /** Drop the in-memory key (lock). */
  public lock(): void {
    this.key = null;
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'locked');
  }

  /**
   * Reset: forget the master password + salt. Existing enc:v1 fields become
   * permanently unreadable (upstream "forget = unrecoverable").
   */
  public reset(): void {
    try {
      if (fileIo.accessSync(this.metaPath)) {
        fileIo.unlinkSync(this.metaPath);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      hilog.error(DOMAIN, TAG, 'reset unlink fail %{public}s', JSON.stringify(e));
    }
    this.meta = null;
    this.key = null;
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, 'master password reset (old ciphertexts unrecoverable)');
  }

  /** Encrypt one field. Fails closed when not unlocked. */
  public async seal(plain: string): Promise<string> {
    if (this.key === null) {
      throw new CredError('fail-closed: master password not unlocked');
    }
    return encryptField(plain, this.key);
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt one field. Fails closed when not unlocked. Returns null when the
   * value is empty; caller marks enc:v1 values it cannot decrypt (wrong
   * master password) instead of silently emptying them.
   */
  public async open(value: string): Promise<string> {
    if (value.length === 0) {

/* ========== 第 33 页 ========== */
      return '';
    }
    if (!isEncrypted(value)) {
      return value; // legacy plaintext (imported file without master password)
    }
    if (this.key === null) {
      throw new CredError('fail-closed: enc:v1 field present but master password not unlocked');
    }
    try {
      return await decryptField(value, this.key);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof EncError) {
        throw new CredError('decrypt failed (wrong master password?)');
      }
      const be = e as Error;
      throw new CredError(be.message);
    }
  }

  /** Prefix check helper for UI badging. */
  public static isEnc(value: string): boolean {
    return value.indexOf(ENC_PREFIX) === 0;
  }
}

function b64u(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  const helper = new util.Base64Helper();
  const out = helper.encodeSync(bytes, util.Type.BASIC);
  const td = util.TextDecoder.create('utf-8');
  return td.decodeWithStream(out);
}

function b64d(s: string): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    const helper = new util.Base64Helper();
    return helper.decodeSync(s);
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

      key: 'cmd.spice', icon: '◈', label: 'SPICE', hint: '远程桌面',
      run: () => this.openKindTab('spice', 'SPICE')
    })
    items.push({
      key: 'cmd.split', icon: '◫', label: '分屏', hint: '当前标签钉到右栏',
      run: () => this.toggleSplit()
    })
    // 连接: 按搜索词过滤
    try {
      const ctx = getContext(this) as common.UIAbilityContext
      const store = new ConnectionStore(ctx.filesDir)
      const kw = this.searchText.trim().toLowerCase()
      for (const c of store.connections) {
        const name = (c.name !== '' ? c.name : (c.user + '@' + c.host))
        if (kw !== '' && name.toLowerCase().indexOf(kw) < 0) {
          continue
        }
        items.push({
          key: 'conn.' + c.id, icon: this.cardIcon(c), label: name,
          hint: '打开终端连接',
          run: () => this.openConnTab(c.id)
        })
      }
    } catch (e) {
    }

/* ========== 第 38 页 ========== */
    return items
  }

  // ===== 状态栏数据 =====
  refreshStatusConn(): void {
    const t = this.tabs.find(x => x.id === this.activeTab)
    if (t !== undefined && t.kind === 'terminal') {
      this.statusConn = t.name
      return
    }
    const anyTerm = this.tabs.find(x => x.kind === 'terminal')
    if (anyTerm !== undefined) {
      this.statusConn = anyTerm.name
      return
    }
    this.statusConn = ''
  }

  activeTabKind(): string {
    const t = this.tabs.find(x => x.id === this.activeTab)
    return t !== undefined ? t.kind : 'start'
  }

  activeConnId(): string {
    const t = this.tabs.find(x => x.id === this.activeTab)
    return t !== undefined && (t.kind === 'terminal' || t.kind === 'sftp') ? t.connId : ''
  }

  addStartTab(): void {
    const id = this.nextTabId++
    this.tabs.push({ id: id, name: '开始', kind: 'start', connId: '' })
    this.activeTab = id
  }

  openConnTab(connId: string): void {
    const existing = this.tabs.find(t => t.kind === 'terminal' && t.connId === connId)
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      this.activeTab = existing.id
      return
    }
    let name = '终端'
    try {
      const ctx = getContext(this) as common.UIAbilityContext
      const store = new ConnectionStore(ctx.filesDir)
      const c = store.connections.find((x: ConnRec) => x.id === connId)
      if (c !== undefined) {
        name = c.name !== '' ? c.name : (c.user + '@' + c.host)
      }
    } catch (e) {
    }

/* ========== 第 39 页 ========== */
    const id = this.nextTabId++
    this.tabs.push({ id: id, name: name, kind: 'terminal', connId: connId })
    this.activeTab = id
  }

  toggleSplit(): void {
    const t = this.tabs.find(x => x.id === this.activeTab)
    if (t === undefined) {
      return
    }
    if (this.splitTabId === t.id) {
      this.splitTabId = -1
      return
    }
    if (t.kind === 'terminal') {
      return
    }
    this.splitTabId = t.id
  }

  splitTab(): TabInfo | null {
    if (this.splitTabId < 0) {
      return null
    }
    return this.tabs.find(x => x.id === this.splitTabId) ?? null
  }

  openKindTab(kind: string, name: string): void {
    const existing = this.tabs.find(t => t.kind === kind)
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      this.activeTab = existing.id
      return
    }
    const id = this.nextTabId++
    this.tabs.push({ id: id, name: name, kind: kind, connId: '' })
    this.activeTab = id
  }

  openSettingsTab(): void {
    this.openKindTab('settings', '设置')
  }

  // M5 relay4 fix(bug1): StartPane Local Terminal 的落点 — 确保 store 有
  // type=local 连接(共享实例,防解密态被磁盘密文覆盖)后开终端标签。
  openLocalTerminal(): void {
    const ctx = getContext(this) as common.UIAbilityContext
    const store = getSharedStore()
    if (store === null) {
      return
    }

/* ========== 第 40 页 ========== */
    let local = store.connections.find((c: ConnRec) => c.type === 'local')
    if (local === undefined) {
      const c = new ConnRec()
      c.id = 'local-term-' + Date.now().toString(36)
      c.name = '本地终端'
      c.type = 'local'
      store.upsertConn(c)
      store.save()
      local = c
    }
    this.openConnTab(local.id)
  }

  openSftpTab(connId: string): void {
    const existing = this.tabs.find(t => t.kind === 'sftp' && t.connId === connId)
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      this.activeTab = existing.id
      return
    }
    const id = this.nextTabId++
    this.tabs.push({ id: id, name: 'SFTP', kind: 'sftp', connId: connId })
    this.activeTab = id
  }

  closeTab(id: number): void {
    if (this.tabs.length <= 1) {
      return
    }
    const idx = this.tabs.findIndex(t => t.id === id)
    this.tabs.splice(idx, 1)
    if (this.activeTab === id) {
      this.activeTab = this.tabs[Math.max(0, idx - 1)].id
    }
  }

  // ===== 命令栏图标钮(悬停高亮+tooltip) =====
  @Builder
  HeaderBtn(icon: string, tip: string, action: () => void) {
    Text(icon)
      .fontSize(18)
      .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
      .fontColor(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === tip ? this.th.brand : this.th.iconStrong)
      .width(30)
      .height(30)
      .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
      .borderRadius(6)
      .margin({ left: 2, right: 2 })
      .backgroundColor(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === tip ? this.th.hover : Color.Transparent)
      .onClick(() => action())
      .onHover((h: boolean) => {

/* ========== 第 41 页 ========== */
        this.hoverTip = h ? tip : ''
        this.hoverOn = h
      })
      .bindPopup(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === tip, {
        message: tip,
        placementOnTop: true
      })
  }

  // ===== TabsList pill(28px 圆角卡片条,命令栏正下方) =====
  @Builder
  TabItem(t: TabInfo) {
    Row({ space: 5 }) {
      Text(t.kind === 'start' ? '⌂' : (t.kind === 'sftp' ? '▦' : (t.kind === 'settings' ? '⚙' : '▸')))
        .fontSize(14)
        .fontColor(t.id === this.activeTab ? this.th.surface : this.th.inkSubtle)
      Text(t.name)
        .fontSize(12)
        .maxLines(1)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
        .fontColor(t.id === this.activeTab ? this.th.surface : this.th.inkSubtle)
        .constraintSize({ maxWidth: 180 })
      Text('×')
        .fontSize(12)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === ('close' + t.id.toString()) ? this.th.danger : (t.id === this.activeTab ? this.th.surface : this.th.inkSubtle))
        .padding({ left: 4, right: 4, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
        .borderRadius(3)
        .onClick(() => this.closeTab(t.id))
        .onHover((h: boolean) => {
          this.hoverTip = h ? ('close' + t.id.toString()) : ''
          this.hoverOn = h
        })
        .bindPopup(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === ('close' + t.id.toString()), {
          message: '关闭标签 ' + t.name,
          placementOnTop: true
        })
    }
    .height(24)
    .constraintSize({ minWidth: 110 })
    .padding({ left: 10, right: 6 })
    .borderRadius(12)
    .backgroundColor(t.id === this.activeTab ? this.th.brand : this.th.panel)
    .border({ width: 1, color: t.id === this.activeTab ? this.th.brand : this.th.hairline })
    .margin({ left: 2, right: 2 })
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
    .onClick(() => {
      this.activeTab = t.id
    })
  }

/* ========== 第 42 页 ========== */

  // ===== 左坞图标钮(窄态56/宽态200 共用;宽态右侧带文字) =====
  @Builder
  DockIcon(idx: number) {
    Row({ space: 8 }) {
      Text(this.sideIcons[idx])
        .fontSize(20)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(this.sideView === idx ? this.th.surface : this.th.iconStrong)
        .width(28)
        .height(28)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .borderRadius(6)
      if (this.dockWide) {
        Text(this.sideViewNames[idx])
          .fontSize(12)
          .fontWeight(this.sideView === idx ? FontWeight.Bold : FontWeight.Normal)
          .fontColor(this.sideView === idx ? this.th.surface : this.th.inkSubtle)
          .layoutWeight(1)
      }
    }
    .height(32)
    .width(this.dockWide ? '100%' : 56)
    .padding({ left: this.dockWide ? 10 : 14 })
    .borderRadius(this.dockWide ? 8 : 6)
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
    .backgroundColor(this.sideView === idx ? this.th.brand : (this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === ('side' + idx.toString()) ? this.th.hover : Color.Transparent))
    .onClick(() => {
      this.sideView = idx
      this.sidebarVisible = true
    })
    .onHover((h: boolean) => {
      this.hoverTip = h ? ('side' + idx.toString()) : ''
      this.hoverOn = h
    })
    .bindPopup(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === ('side' + idx.toString()) && !this.dockWide, {
      message: this.sideTips[idx],
      placementOnTop: true
    })
  }

  // ===== 工作台卡片辅助 =====
  cardMeta(c: ConnRec): string {
    if (c.type === 'local') return 'local';
    let s = c.user + '@' + c.host;
    if (c.port !== 22) s += ':' + c.port.toString();
    return s;
  }

  cardIcon(c: ConnRec): string {

/* ========== 第 43 页 ========== */
    if (c.type === 'local') return '▤';
    if (c.type === 'rdp') return '▣';
    if (c.type === 'vnc') return '◫';
    if (c.type === 'k8s') return '☸';
    if (c.type === 'redis' || c.type === 'mysql' || c.type === 'pg') return '⬮';
    return '⌗';
  }

  cardIconColor(c: ConnRec): string {
    if (c.type === 'local') return '#34d399';
    if (c.type === 'rdp') return '#60a5fa';
    return '#' + this.th.brand.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
  }

  @Builder
  StartConnCard(c: ConnRec) {
    Row({ space: 10 }) {
      Text(this.cardIcon(c))
        .fontSize(20)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(this.cardIconColor(c))
        .width(34)
        .height(34)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .borderRadius(8)
        .backgroundColor(this.th.surfaceRaised)
      Column({ space: 2 }) {
        Text(c.name)
          .fontSize(13)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
          .fontColor(this.th.ink)
          .maxLines(1)
          .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
        Text(this.cardMeta(c))
          .fontSize(11)
          .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
          .maxLines(1)
          .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
      }
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
      .layoutWeight(1)
    }
    .width(230)
    .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 10, bottom: 10 })
    .borderRadius(12)
    .backgroundColor(this.th.panel)
    .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
    .onClick(() => {
      if (c.type === 'ssh') {

/* ========== 第 44 页 ========== */
        this.openConnTab(c.id)
      }
    })
  }

  // ===== 命令面板下拉(focus 搜索框时展开;点击条目执行) =====
  @Builder
  PaletteRow(item: PaletteItem, idx: number) {
    Row({ space: 8 }) {
      Text(item.icon)
        .fontSize(15)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(this.paletteSel === idx ? this.th.brand : this.th.iconStrong)
        .width(20)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
      Text(item.label)
        .fontSize(12)
        .fontColor(this.paletteSel === idx ? this.th.ink : this.th.inkSubtle)
        .maxLines(1)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
        .layoutWeight(1)
      Text(item.hint)
        .fontSize(10)
        .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
        .maxLines(1)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(30)
    .padding({ left: 12, right: 12 })
    .borderRadius(6)
    .backgroundColor(this.paletteSel === idx ? this.th.hover : Color.Transparent)
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
    .onClick(() => {
      this.paletteFocus = false
      item.run()
    })
    .onHover((h: boolean) => {
      if (h) {
        this.paletteSel = idx
      }
    })
  }

  @Builder
  CommandPalette() {
    Column() {
      ForEach(this.paletteItems(), (item: PaletteItem, idx: number) => {
        this.PaletteRow(item, idx)
      }, (item: PaletteItem) => item.key + '.' + this.searchText)
    }
    .width(360)
    .constraintSize({ maxHeight: 300 })

/* ========== 第 49 页 ========== */
    .padding(6)
    .borderRadius(10)
    .backgroundColor(this.th.surfaceRaised)
    .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
    .shadow({ radius: 24, color: '#99000000', offsetX: 0, offsetY: 8 })
    .position({ x: 210, y: 4 })
  }

  // ===== 设置下拉菜单(命令栏齿轮) =====
  @Builder

    Column({ space: 1 }) {
      Text('主题')

        Text(n === 'dark' ? '● 暗色' : '● 浅色')
          .fontSize(12)

      }, (n: string) => n)
      Divider()

        .color(this.th.hairline)
        .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 4 })
      Text('设置')
        .fontSize(12)

        .borderRadius(4)

/* ========== 第 50 页 ========== */

      Text('关于')

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
      // ===== 命令栏(44px): 品牌 + 坞折叠钮 + 搜索命令面板 + AI/齿轮/分屏 =====
      Row() {
        Text('一站AI终端')
          .fontSize(14)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(this.th.brand)
          .margin({ left: 12, right: 4 })
        this.HeaderBtn(this.dockWide ? '«' : '»', this.dockWide ? '收起侧坞' : '展开侧坞', () => {
          this.dockWide = !this.dockWide
          this.sidebarVisible = true
        })
        this.HeaderBtn('⌗', '连接列表', () => {
          this.sideView = 0
          this.sidebarVisible = !this.sidebarVisible
        })
        // 搜索命令面板(focus 展开;失焦收起;回车执行选中项)

/* ========== 第 51 页 ========== */
        Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.TopStart }) {
          TextInput({ placeholder: '搜索命令或连接...', text: this.searchText })
            .onChange((v: string) => {
              this.searchText = v
              this.paletteSel = 0
            })
            .onFocus(() => {
              this.paletteFocus = true
            })
            .onBlur(() => {
              this.paletteFocus = false
            })
            .onSubmit(() => {
              const items = this.paletteItems()
              if (items.length > 0) {
                const pick = items[Math.min(this.paletteSel, items.length - 1)]
                this.paletteFocus = false
                pick.run()
              }
            })
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontColor(this.th.ink)
            .placeholderColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
            .height(30)
            .width(240)
            .backgroundColor(this.th.inputBg)
            .borderRadius(6)
            .padding({ left: 12, right: 12 })
            .underlineColor(Color.Transparent)
            .caretColor(this.th.brand)
          if (this.paletteFocus) {
            this.CommandPalette()
          }
        }
        .width(240)
        .height(30)
        Blank()
        this.HeaderBtn('▣', '分屏', () => this.toggleSplit())
        // M6 relay3: 智能体 Dock 切换钮
        this.HeaderBtn('✧', '智能体', () => {
          this.aiDockOpen = !this.aiDockOpen
        })
        this.HeaderBtn('⚙', '设置', () => {
          this.showSettingsMenu = !this.showSettingsMenu
        })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height(44)
      .padding({ left: 0, right: 8 })
      .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)

/* ========== 第 52 页 ========== */
      .backgroundColor(this.th.surfaceRaised)
      .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: this.th.hairline })

      // ===== TabsList pill 条(28px,命令栏正下方,可横滚) =====
      Scroll() {
          Row({ space: 2 }) {
            ForEach(this.tabs, (t: TabInfo) => {
              this.TabItem(t)
            }, (t: TabInfo) => t.id.toString())
            Text('+')
              .fontSize(15)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
              .fontColor(this.th.iconMuted)
              .width(26)
              .height(26)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
              .borderRadius(13)
              .backgroundColor(this.th.panel)
              .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
              .onClick(() => this.addStartTab())
              .onHover((h: boolean) => {
                this.hoverTip = h ? 'newTab' : ''
                this.hoverOn = h
              })
              .bindPopup(this.hoverOn && this.hoverTip === 'newTab', {
                message: '新建开始标签页',
                placementOnTop: true
              })
          }
          .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
        }
        .scrollable(ScrollDirection.Horizontal)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
        .height(28)
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: 12 })
        .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 4 })
        .backgroundColor(this.th.surfaceRaised)
        .border({ width: { top: 1, bottom: 1 }, color: this.th.hairline })

      // ===== 主体 =====
      Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.TopEnd }) {
        Row() {
          if (this.sidebarVisible) {
            Column() {
              // 坞顶: 视图切换 icon(双态)
              Column({ space: 2 }) {
                ForEach([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], (i: number) => {
                  this.DockIcon(i)
                }, (i: number) => i.toString() + (this.dockWide ? 'w' : 'n'))

/* ========== 第 53 页 ========== */
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ top: 8, bottom: 4 })

              // 宽态: 视图名 + 面板内容(连接视图嵌 ConnList)
              if (this.dockWide) {
                Text(this.sideViewNames[this.sideView])
                  .fontSize(11)
                  .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
                  .letterSpacing(1)
                  .width('100%')
                  .padding({ left: 12, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                  .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: this.th.hairline })
                  .margin({ bottom: 4 })

                if (this.sideView === 0) {
                  ConnList({
                    onOpenConn: (id: string) => {
                      this.openConnTab(id)
                    },
                    onNeedStore: (): ConnectionStore => {
                      const ctx = getContext(this) as common.UIAbilityContext
                      return new ConnectionStore(ctx.filesDir)
                    }
                  })
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else if (this.sideView === 1) {
                  FileSidebar()
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else if (this.sideView === 2) {
                  MonitorPanel()
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else if (this.sideView === 4) {
                  QuickCommandsPanel()
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else if (this.sideView === 5) {
                  HistoryPanel()
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else if (this.sideView === 6) {
                  PersonalizationPanel({
                    onThemeChange: (t: string) => this.applyTheme(t)
                  })
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else if (this.sideView === 7) {
                  // M6 relay5: 工作台(补位,行为同 sideView=0 开始页)
                  ConnList({
                    onOpenConn: (id: string) => {
                      this.openConnTab(id)
                    },
                    onNeedStore: (): ConnectionStore => {

/* ========== 第 54 页 ========== */
                      const ctx = getContext(this) as common.UIAbilityContext
                      return new ConnectionStore(ctx.filesDir)
                    }
                  })
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                } else {
                  Column() {
                    Text(this.sideTips[this.sideView])
                      .fontSize(13)
                      .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
                      .margin(16)
                    Text('按官方路线图逐步开放')
                      .fontSize(11)
                      .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
                  }
                  .layoutWeight(1)
                  .width('100%')
                }
              } else {
                Blank()
              }
            }
            .width(this.dockWide ? 200 : 56)
            .height('100%')
            .backgroundColor(this.th.surface)
            .border({ width: { right: 1 }, color: this.th.hairline })
          }

          // 内容区:主栏 + 可选分屏右栏(relay4: 业务窗口外框 1px hairline+圆角,
          // 外层 Column 承载边框属性,内层保留 layoutWeight/height 链防塌缩)
          Row() {
            Column() {
              Column() {
              if (this.activeTabKind() === 'terminal') {
                TerminalPage({ connIdIn: this.activeConnId() })
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'sftp') {
                SftpPanel({
                  connIdIn: this.activeConnId(),
                  onClose: () => {
                    const t = this.tabs.find(x => x.id === this.activeTab)
                    if (t !== undefined) {
                      this.closeTab(t.id)
                    }
                  }
                })
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'settings') {
                SettingsTab({
                  onThemeChange: (t: string) => this.applyTheme(t)
                })
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'redis') {

/* ========== 第 55 页 ========== */
                RedisTab()
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'k8s') {
                K8sTab()
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'pg') {
                PgTab()
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'mysql') {
                MySqlTab()
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'vnc') {
                VncTab()
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'rdp') {
                RdpTab()
              } else if (this.activeTabKind() === 'spice') {
                SpiceTab()
              } else {
                this.StartPane()
              }
              }
              .layoutWeight(1)
              .height('100%')
              .margin(6)
              .borderRadius(10)
              .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
              .clip(true)
              .backgroundColor(this.th.surface)
            }
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .height('100%')

            if (this.splitTab() !== null && this.splitTabId !== this.activeTab) {
              Column() {
                Column() {
                if (this.splitTab()!.kind === 'sftp') {
                  SftpPanel({
                    connIdIn: this.splitTab()!.connId,
                    onClose: () => {
                      this.splitTabId = -1
                    }
                  })
                } else if (this.splitTab()!.kind === 'settings') {
                  SettingsTab({
                    onThemeChange: (t: string) => this.applyTheme(t)
                  })
                } else {
                  this.StartPane()
                }
                }
                .layoutWeight(1)
                .height('100%')
                .margin(6)
                .borderRadius(10)

/* ========== 第 56 页 ========== */
                .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
                .clip(true)
                .backgroundColor(this.th.surface)
              }
              .layoutWeight(1)
              .height('100%')
            }
          }
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height('100%')
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')

        if (this.showSettingsMenu) {
          this.SettingsMenu()
        }
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .width('100%')

      // ===== M6 relay3: AI 智能体 Dock(主体与状态栏之间, 横跨全宽) =====
      if (this.aiDockOpen) {
        AIDock()
      }

      // ===== 底部状态栏(24px) =====
      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Row({ space: 6 }) {
          Circle()
            .width(8)
            .height(8)
            .fill(this.statusConn !== '' ? this.th.success : this.th.inkSubtle)
          Text(this.statusConn !== '' ? this.statusConn : '未连接')
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(this.statusConn !== '' ? this.th.ink : this.th.inkSubtle)
            .maxLines(1)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
            .constraintSize({ maxWidth: 200 })
        }
        .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)

        Text('UTF-8')
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
        Text('v1.1.0')
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
        Blank()
        Text('一站AI终端 · One AI Term')

/* ========== 第 57 页 ========== */
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height(24)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12 })
      .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
      .backgroundColor(this.th.surfaceRaised)
      .border({ width: { top: 1 }, color: this.th.hairline })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(this.th.surface)

      if (this.guideShow) {
        GuideOverlay({ onFinish: () => this.finishGuide() })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}



// ===== 文件: AppTheme.ets (57 行) =====
// 一站AI终端(One AI Term)自有主题色板 —— M6 relay2 品牌差异化定案
// 深色: 深夜蓝紫底 + 琥珀 brand;浅色: 暖白底 + 深琥珀 brand(可读性)。
// 字段语义: surface=全局底/surfaceRaised=浮层/panel=面板/hover=悬停/ink=主文/inkSubtle=次文/
// brand=品牌色/hairline=发丝线;success/warn/danger/inputBg/iconMuted 保留 relay1 语义。
export class AppTheme {
  surface: number
  surfaceRaised: number
  panel: number
  hover: number
  ink: number
  inkSubtle: number
  brand: number
  hairline: number
  success: number
  warn: number
  danger: number
  inputBg: number
  iconMuted: number
  iconStrong: number

  constructor(surface: number, surfaceRaised: number, panel: number, hover: number,
    ink: number, inkSubtle: number, brand: number, hairline: number,
    success: number, warn: number, danger: number, inputBg: number, iconMuted: number,
    iconStrong: number) {

/* ========== 第 58 页 ========== */
    this.surface = surface
    this.surfaceRaised = surfaceRaised
    this.panel = panel
    this.hover = hover
    this.ink = ink
    this.inkSubtle = inkSubtle
    this.brand = brand
    this.hairline = hairline
    this.success = success
    this.warn = warn
    this.danger = danger
    this.inputBg = inputBg
    this.iconMuted = iconMuted
    this.iconStrong = iconStrong
  }
}

// dark: 深夜蓝紫底 + 琥珀 brand(relay4: 分层亮度差拉大 ≥8%,hairline 提亮,新增 iconStrong 高对比图标色)
export const THEME_DARK: AppTheme = new AppTheme(0x0F1220, 0x1E2438, 0x232A44, 0x2A3252,
  0xE8EAF2, 0x8a90a5, 0xF5A524, 0x353D5E, 0x34d399, 0xf59e0b, 0xf87171, 0x131729, 0x9aa2b8,
  0xF2F4FA)
// light: 暖白底 + 深琥珀 brand(relay4: 分层亮度差拉大 ≥8%,hairline 加深,新增 iconStrong)
export const THEME_LIGHT: AppTheme = new AppTheme(0xFAFAF7, 0xE8E5DA, 0xEBE8DE, 0xE0DCCF,
  0x1c1c1a, 0x6b6a66, 0xD97706, 0xCFCABC, 0x108038, 0xb45309, 0xc62828, 0xF6F5F1, 0x6b6a66,
  0x26262B)

export function themeByName(name: string): AppTheme {
  if (name === 'light') {
    return THEME_LIGHT
  }
  return THEME_DARK
}


// ===== 文件: GuideOverlay.ets (115 行) =====
// relay4 C1: 首启 4 步引导浮层(欢迎→新建连接→终端与AI Dock→设置与主题)
// 可跳过;完成/跳过均调 onFinish(Index 写 filesDir/guide_done 标记永不再弹)
import { AppTheme, themeByName } from '../common/AppTheme';

@Component
export struct GuideOverlay {
  onFinish: () => void = () => {}
  @State step: number = 0
  @State th: AppTheme = themeByName('dark')

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.th = themeByName(AppStorage.get<string>('ut.theme') ?? 'dark')
  }

  private titles: string[] = [

/* ========== 第 59 页 ========== */
    '欢迎来到一站AI终端',
    '新建你的第一个连接',
    '终端与 AI 智能体',
    '设置与主题'
  ]
  private descs: string[] = [
    'SSH / 本地终端 / 数据库 / 远程桌面,一个应用全搞定。左侧坞切换功能,顶栏搜索直达一切。',
    '左侧「连接」面板点 + 新建;支持 SSH、本地终端、PostgreSQL、Redis、MySQL、VNC、RDP 等。也可按 Ctrl+K 打开命令面板快速直达。',
    '底部 ✦ 智能体 Dock:用自然语言驱动终端——读写屏幕、执行命令、传输文件,每一步都有审批卡把关。',
    '点顶栏齿轮进设置:AI 模型配置(Anthropic / OpenAI 兼容)、主题深浅切换、数据导入导出都在这里。'
  ]
  private icons: string[] = ['✦', '+', '▣', '⚙']

  next(): void {
    if (this.step >= 3) {
      this.onFinish()
      return
    }
    this.step++
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
        // 步序点
        Row({ space: 6 }) {
          ForEach([0, 1, 2, 3], (i: number) => {
            Circle()
              .width(i === this.step ? 8 : 6)
              .height(i === this.step ? 8 : 6)
              .fill(i <= this.step ? this.th.brand : this.th.hairline)
          }, (i: number) => i.toString() + (i === this.step ? 'a' : 'b'))
        }
        .margin({ bottom: 16 })

        Text(this.icons[this.step])
          .fontSize(36)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(this.th.iconStrong)
          .width(72)
          .height(72)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .borderRadius(20)
          .backgroundColor(this.th.surface)
          .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
          .margin({ bottom: 14 })

        Text(this.titles[this.step])
          .fontSize(18)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)

/* ========== 第 60 页 ========== */
          .fontColor(this.th.ink)
          .margin({ bottom: 10 })

        Text(this.descs[this.step])
          .fontSize(13)
          .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .lineHeight(20)
          .padding({ left: 12, right: 12 })

        Row({ space: 10 }) {
          Text(this.step === 3 ? '完成' : '跳过')
            .fontSize(13)
            .fontColor(this.th.inkSubtle)
            .height(36)
            .padding({ left: 18, right: 18 })
            .borderRadius(18)
            .backgroundColor(this.th.surface)
            .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
            .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
            .onClick(() => this.onFinish())
          Text(this.step === 3 ? '开始使用' : '下一步')
            .fontSize(13)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(this.th.surface)
            .height(36)
            .padding({ left: 22, right: 22 })
            .borderRadius(18)
            .backgroundColor(this.th.brand)
            .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
            .onClick(() => this.next())
        }
        .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
        .margin({ top: 22 })
      }
      .width(380)
      .padding({ top: 30, bottom: 26, left: 24, right: 24 })
      .borderRadius(14)
      .backgroundColor(this.th.surfaceRaised)
      .border({ width: 1, color: this.th.hairline })
      .shadow({ radius: 24, color: '#99000000', offsetX: 0, offsetY: 8 })
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Center)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor('rgba(0,0,0,0.55)')
    .alignContent(Alignment.Center)
  }
}
